meta_title: Adore Dental | Non-prep veneers in Kangaroo Point, Brisbane
meta_desc: Non-prep veneers, implants and Invisalign in Kangaroo Point, Brisbane. Founder-led cosmetic dentistry with Dr. Ellie Kim.
hero_sub: Founder-led cosmetic dentistry from Dr. Ellie Kim, in Kangaroo Point, Brisbane.
about_body:
Adore Dental is a cosmetic practice in Kangaroo Point, Brisbane, founded by Dr. Ellie Kim. She specialises in non-prep veneers, changing the shape and colour of a smile while keeping as much natural tooth structure as possible.

Dr. Kim also lectures to other dentists and is the founder of Endear Beauty, so the practice sits where clinical detail and aesthetics meet. Every case starts with a planned design, not a guess.

services.name: Non-prep veneers
services.blurb: Veneers designed to reshape the smile while preserving natural tooth structure.

services.name: Smile design planning
services.blurb: Your smile is designed and reviewed with you before any treatment begins.

services.name: Dental implants
services.blurb: Replacements for missing teeth, planned to sit naturally with the rest of the smile.

services.name: Invisalign
services.blurb: Clear aligners to straighten teeth, often as groundwork before veneer treatment.

footer_tagline: Non-prep veneers, implants and Invisalign in Kangaroo Point.
why_this_angle: Put Dr. Kim's name and her lecturing and founder role up front, because specialty and role show a clinician-led offer that the current site never credits.
